notes: 19 reserves. Base game: Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve and Layton Lake District (2017-02-16). All others are paid DLC; release dates are Steam release dates. sizeKm2 is null for all reserves because no official size is published. Species names follow cotwguide.com spelling.

reserves.name: Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve
reserves.biome: Deciduous beech and aspen forests around rolling hills and farmland; mountain slopes and deep spruce forests in the west.
reserves.about: One of the two original base-game reserves. A central European hunting estate of rolling farmland and beech/aspen woods, harder going on the western spruce-covered slopes.
reserves.notes: Base game (released with the game on 2017-02-16 per Wikipedia). No country stated by sources; described only as central Europe. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

sources.title: CoTW Guide reserve page (hirschfelden)

reserves.name: Layton Lake District
reserves.biome: Spruce, larch and aspen forests, rocky mountain slopes and marshland.
reserves.about: The other original base-game reserve: Pacific Northwest lakes, conifer forest and marshes, home to elk, moose, deer and black bear.
reserves.notes: Base game (released with the game on 2017-02-16 per Wikipedia). Sources say 'Pacific Northwest of North America' without naming a country. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Medved-Taiga National Park
reserves.biome: Taiga with frozen valleys and mountains and unreliable weather.
reserves.about: A cold Siberian taiga reserve of frozen valleys and mountains; home to brown bear, lynx, wolves, moose and musk deer.
reserves.notes: Country inferred from 'Siberia' (cotwguide says 'a northern part of Asia'). No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Vurhonga Savanna
reserves.biome: Savanna, woodlands, fever tree forests, swamps and scrublands.
reserves.about: An African savanna reserve spanning open grassland, woodland, fever tree forest and swamp; the reserve that introduced lion and Cape buffalo.
reserves.notes: cotwguide says 'south-west Africa'; Wikipedia says 'Southern Africa'. No country named. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Parque Fernando
reserves.biome: Where the Patagonian steppe meets southern beech forest; wetlands, grasslands, forests and highlands.
reserves.about: An Argentine reserve where barren Patagonian steppe meets southern beech forest, with red deer, water buffalo, blackbuck and puma.
reserves.notes: Region 'Patagonia' taken from cotwguide's description of the 'Patagonian Steppe'. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.notes: No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Salzwiesen Park
reserves.biome: North German coastal salt-meadow country; a waterfowl reserve with a clay pigeon range.
reserves.about: A northern German waterfowl and small-game reserve in Schleswig-Holstein, with ducks, geese, raccoon dog and fox, plus a clay pigeon shooting range.
reserves.notes: Biome text summarises cotwguide ('uncut gem of North Germany', waterfowl reserve); the source gives no formal biome. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Askiy Ridge Hunting Preserve
reserves.biome: Pine-covered Rocky Mountain peaks, boreal forest, foothills and frost-swept grassland.
reserves.about: A cold Alberta preserve between the Rockies, southern foothills and northern boreal forest: 19 species including Manitoban elk, wood bison, woodland caribou and North American beaver.
reserves.notes: Sold on Steam as 'Alberta Hunting Preserve'; the reserve is Askiy Ridge. The Steam page also mentions the Sasquatch, which is not on the huntable list. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.name: Tòrr nan Sìthean
reserves.biome: Highland mountains, green valleys, lochs and Celtic woodland on a craggy coast.
reserves.about: A Scottish Highland estate for stag stalking and lowland bird driving: mountains, lochs and woodland, steeped in legend (hence the Wild Haggis).
reserves.notes: Sold on Steam as 'Scotland Hunting Reserve'. The Steam page says '17 iconic animals' in one place and '18 animals' in another; cotwguide lists 18 (incl. Wild Haggis). Steam spells it 'Torr nan Sithean' without accents. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).

reserves.notes: Sold as 'Peru Hunting Reserve'. No official reserve size found; Expansive Worlds publishes no km2 figures (community estimates only).
